text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Holding off formidable rivals, snatching a 
magnificent 1st place, it's Win 
Variation...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I won, I won, I beat her...! Against 
her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...! That's right, no, not yet—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (—How about it? Today's the day...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Why isn't it in my hands...! Why—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Orfeee! Lord Orfeee!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...... Heh—so you seek it with such greed, 
my subject?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will never halt my steps. The 
golden path of supremacy shall not be 
broken...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Shioooon!! That was totally sick!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! Well done! You did so 
well!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haha... Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stands took on a color unlike anything 
seen before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Voices supporting Orfevre's brilliance, 
and voices praising Win Variation for her 
hard-fought effort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cheers, which had been almost entirely 
unified until now, split into two and roar 
across Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright. Yes, yes, yes, yes, 
yeeesss...!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I made it, I made it this far! I still 
can't puff out my chest and call myself 
the star... but still!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If I keep giving it my all like this, I'll 
definitely be able to reach her...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To become something like that—the most 
beautiful, most radiant existence... Me 
too, even I want to!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Trainer! Um, there's a race I 
wanna enter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race proposed by the enthusiastic girl 
was—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm plannin' to run in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup— A Japanese GⅠ race where 
Umamusume from all over the world clash!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista, who's been dominating the 
Senior Year, is also scheduled to run, 
right? Could we get a word on your 
enthusiasm?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I might not even stand a chance, 
but... well, I really want to try!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
We've made it this far, so I started 
thinking that maybe we can go even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Crossing generations, crossing borders, I 
want to race all kinds of strong Umamusume 
and become stronger and stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
And so, if I can break out of my shell, I 
know I can definitely beat her!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see...! By the way, who do you mean by 
"that person"?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-ummm...!
choice_data_list: Anyway, look forward to what's to come!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Th-That's right! Look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Moved by Win Variation's passionate plea, 
I gladly agreed to enter the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To overcome the formidable runners in the 
field, the days of rigorous training have 
begun!
